tournaments.name: Billie Jean King Cup Finals
tournaments.note: Won by Czechia (12th title), 2–0 over Ukraine in the final. Czech captain: Barbora Strycova.

tournaments.name: WTA Finals
tournaments.note: Indian Wells Tennis Garden. The top eight in the Race, two groups of four. Qualified: Elena Rybakina, Aryna Sabalenka, Mirra Andreeva, Jessica Pegula, Coco Gauff, Elina Svitolina, Karolina Muchova, Linda Noskova. The group draw has not taken place yet.
